3\. A valid suite can block a task-base pin 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
pin_suite_text looks for the literal JSON spelling "task_base" before parsing the suite. JSON
permits an escaped property name such as "\u0074ask_base", which resolves to the required runtime
field and can pass schema validation but causes this pin command to report that the field is
missing.
